collaboratorOutreachTemplates.segment: Pediatric Nutritionists & Registered Dietitians in Nepal
collaboratorOutreachTemplates.targetContent: Single-Ingredient Weaning Powders (Dates Powder, Sweet Potato Powder, Carrot Powder, Banana Powder)
collaboratorOutreachTemplates.complianceRule: Strictly factual ingredient review only; always include "from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician"; zero disease/cure claims.
collaboratorOutreachTemplates.messageTemplate: Namaste [Name] ji, we at NaturesMud Nepal (Baneshwor, Kathmandu) prepare 100% single-ingredient dehydrated fruit and vegetable powders (Dates Powder, Sweet Potato Powder, Carrot Powder, Banana Powder) in glass jars with 0% added sugar, 0% salt, and 0% preservatives. We would love to send you a complimentary tasting & inspection box from our Baneshwor hub so you can examine the ingredient purity and texture firsthand. No scripted claims—just your honest professional feedback.

collaboratorOutreachTemplates.complianceRule: Must show real spoon texture & preparation; include "from 6 months, as advised by your pediatrician"; no fabricated health claims.
collaboratorOutreachTemplates.messageTemplate: Namaste [Creator Name] ji! Loved your recent video on homemade baby food in Nepal.
